items.item_text: 01. This application will ONLY be used to fill TEMPORARY positions with SCCCD. Are you available for a temporary position at this time? Options: Yes | No
02. This application will ONLY be used to fill part-time vacancies in this specific classification. Do you understand this working condition? Options: Yes | No
03. (MQ) Please select the level of education you possess: Options: Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade OR no related degree
04. (MQ) Do you possess at least one year of responsible experience providing instructional or tutorial assistance to students: Options: Yes | No

05. (MQ) Please describe your related experience where you obtained experience in providing instructional or tutorial assistance to students - Name of the employer(s) - Position title(s) you held - Type of duties: This information will need to be identifiable in the work history section of your application or your application may be rejected

06. (MR) Certain assignments may require a California driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the Districts vehicle insurance program. Do you possess a valid driver's license? Options: Yes | No
Certain assignments may require a California driver's license and the ability to maintain insurability under the Districts vehicle insurance program.
